core_obligations: The compatible family (varphi_V)_{V in B} with varphi_V : G(V) -> F(f^{-1}V) is exactly a morphism between the restrictions of G and f_*F to the basis B (proof lines 4493-4496). By lemma-restrict-basis-equivalence-structures this extends uniquely to a morphism G -> f_*F (proof lines 4496-4498); by the f-map lemma this is the same as an f-map varphi (proof lines 4498-4499), and for V in B the recovered composition G(V) -> F(f^{-1}V) -> F(U) restricts to the given varphi_V^U; the algebraic-structure case is handled by lemma-f-map-sets-algebraic-structures and the preceding discussion (proof lines 4500-4503).
proof_roadmap: Read the basis data as a morphism of restrictions to B (proof lines 4493-4496).
Extend via restrict-basis-equivalence-structures and convert to an f-map via the f-map lemma (proof lines 4496-4499).
Address the algebraic-structure case via the sets lemma (proof lines 4500-4503).
